pins.label: Neighborhood Hopper
pins.get: Go to classes in different neighborhoods to get this pin!

pins.label: Repeater Reward
pins.get: Go back to a class you’ve been to before to get this pin!

pins.label: Year-Rounder
pins.get: Do after school, a weekend class, a day-off camp or summer camp. Each kind in each school year counts!

pins.label: City Sampler
pins.get: Go to classes in two different parts of Philly!

pins.label: Secret Spotter
pins.get: Find a secret spot on your map!

pins.label: Surprise Sleuth
pins.get: Find a surprise in a neighborhood on your map!

pins.label: Mix Master
pins.get: Try two different kinds of classes!

pins.label: Triple Threat
pins.one: round of music, theater and dance
pins.many: rounds of music, theater and dance
pins.get: Do a music class, a theater class AND a dance or sports class!

pins.label: Lab & Easel
pins.get: Do a science class AND an art class!

pins.label: Brains & Bounce
pins.get: Do a reading class AND a sports class!

pins.label: Comeback Kid
pins.get: Go back to a class you loved in a new school year!

pins.label: Tag Team
pins.one: class with a brother or sister
pins.many: classes with a brother or sister
pins.get: Go to a class with your brother or sister!

pins.label: Showdown Judge
pins.get: Pick your favorites in a showdown!

pins.label: Home Base
pins.get: Go to a class right in your own school!

pins.label: Pickup Pro
pins.get: Go to a class that picks you up from school!

pins.label: Liberty Bell Ringer
pins.hint: Somewhere old, a famous bell has a crack in it… and it wants some music!
pins.rule: Do a music class AND a class in Old City or Society Hill. Each pair counts!
parts: In Old City or Society Hill

pins.label: Ben Franklin’s Kite
pins.hint: Ben Franklin flew a kite in a storm. Do what he loved, near where he lived…
pins.rule: Do a science class AND a class in Old City or Society Hill. Each pair counts!
parts: In Old City or Society Hill

pins.label: Billy Penn’s Hat
pins.hint: Look up! Someone in a big hat on City Hall watches the shows below…
pins.rule: Do a theater class AND a class in Center City. Each pair counts!

pins.label: Cheesesteak Champ
pins.hint: Wit or witout? A champ in South Philly plays to win…
pins.rule: Do a games class AND a class in South Philly. Each pair counts!

pins.label: Boathouse Rower
pins.hint: Down by the river, where the boathouses light up at night… grab an oar!
pins.rule: Do a sports class AND a class near the Art Museum: in Fairmount, Spring Garden or along the Parkway. Each pair counts!

pins.label: Wissahickon Wanderer
pins.hint: Deep in the woods of Northwest Philly, something wild is waiting…
pins.rule: Do a nature class AND a class in Northwest Philly. Each pair counts!

pins.label: Heron Spotter
pins.hint: Tall birds wade in the marsh in Southwest Philly… go outside and look!
pins.rule: Do a nature class AND a class in Southwest Philly. Each pair counts!

pins.label: Pennypack Pathfinder
pins.hint: A trail through the trees, way up in Northeast Philly… run it!
pins.rule: Do a sports class AND a class in Northeast Philly. Each pair counts!

pins.label: Bulboa Knockout
pins.hint: A champ trains in South Philly, then runs all the way up the Art Museum steps… gloves on!
pins.rule: A round is a sports class, a class in South Philly AND a class near the Art Museum (in Fairmount, Spring Garden or along the Parkway). Each round counts!

pins.label: Broad Street Crosser
pins.one: class on each side of Broad Street
pins.many: classes on each side of Broad Street
pins.hint: One long street cuts Philly down the middle. Try both sides!
pins.rule: Go to a class on each side of Broad Street, the long street down the middle of Philly. Each east-and-west pair counts!

pins.label: Jawn Collector
pins.hint: Collect a whole lotta jawns: lots of different programs!
pins.rule: Go to lots of different programs. Each new one counts!
